strings.text: Mist over the water. The fisherman and his dog watch the float.
strings.translation: 水面に霧。釣り人と犬が浮きを見つめている。

strings.text: The sun has risen above the mist; the water has brightened
strings.translation: 霧の上に日が昇り、水面が明るくなった

strings.text: The float has gone under: the fisherman has a bite
strings.translation: 浮きが沈んだ。釣り人に当たりが来た

strings.text: Ducks have landed on the water near the boat
strings.translation: ボートのそばの水面に鴨が降りた
